messages:
oncall-bot: P0 ALERT — multiple 502/503 errors observed from eu-prod canary after deploy v3.14.2. paging @sara @mohit. incident id=INC-2026-3377
oncall-bot: severity=critical, affected=eu-prod/model-serving, symptoms=canary 5/10 fail, elevated latency, some node NotReady events
sara: acked. looking now. can anyone confirm if this was a config rollout or a code rollout?
mohit: I see a configmap update landed 5m ago: model-serving-config:v12 -> changed readinessProbe.path and HPA targetMetricName from 'cpu_util' -> 'cpu_utilization' (typo?). deploy-bot shows a canary rollout to 10%
tara: if HPA metric name is wrong it might pull NaN -> scale down. checking k8s HPA events
ian: also getting alerts for kubelet postStart hook failures on nodes eu-gpu-3 and eu-gpu-4 — logs show preStop/postStart script hanging on shutdown after drain started
sara: impact? customer-facing errors?
customer-success: a handful of paying customers in EU reported intermittent 502s starting 00:03 UTC (approx). health-checks show 5% 5xx rate for model infer endpoint.
mohit: grabbing kubectl output. paste: ```kubectl get hpa -n eu-prod model-svc-hpa -o yaml
metrics:
 - type: Resource
   resource:
     name: cpu
     target:
       type: Utilization
       averageUtilization: 60
currentMetrics:
 - object:
     metricName: cpu_utilization
```
ian: that metricName is custom; our stack uses 'cpu_util'. HPA probably reports no metric -> scaled replicas to 0 during canary -> readiness probe failures on 0 replicas -> gateway 502s
tara: I also see: ```Events:
  Warning  FailedGetMetrics  2m (x3 over 4m)  horizontalpodautoscaler-controller  failed to get CPU utilization: resource metrics not found```
sara: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to stop routing traffic to canary, 2) scale deployment replicas manually, 3) revert configmap, 4) disable HPA temporarily. Which should we do first?
mohit: flip routing flag for canary to 0% traffic (kill-switch) — quick and reversible. then we can scale replicas back to stable.
sara: agreed. @iam-deploy (deploy-bot) can you run the kill-switch?
deploy-bot: running canary traffic -> 0%. command: ```/rollout traffic eu-prod model-serving canary=0``` returns status queued -> applied
deploy-bot: traffic now 0% to canary; routing converged per envoy (2/2 traces showing stable)
customer-success: saw errors drop to ~1% within 30s of traffic shift. good so far.
ian: while traffic is cut, let's scale stable replicas to handle backlog: ```kubectl scale deploy model-serving --replicas=6 -n eu-prod```
mohit: scaling up stable worked, pods becoming Ready. also created a hotfix: revert configmap key 'cpu_utilization' -> 'cpu_util' and pushed configmap v11-backwards. applying now
sara: after config revert we should re-enable HPA only after we validate metric scraping. to be safe keep HPA paused: ```kubectl patch hpa model-svc-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}' -n eu-prod```
tara: note — node issues: node eu-gpu-4 had drain attempted earlier and several pods stuck in Terminating due to preStop script. I'm SSHing to the node to check kubelet logs. might be separate but correlated because pods moved around during canary
ian: I see preStop hook calls an s3 sync to drain logs, that's hanging when the node lost internet egress due to a misapplied networkpolicy from the same deploy. Oof, configmap also included a networkpolicy tweak scoped to telemetry-daemonset
sara: action list: 1) keep canary traffic 0% 2) scale stable (done) 3) revert configmap (done) 4) pause HPA/autoscale changes (done) 5) cordon/uncordon nodes carefully after fix to preStop (need devops help)
mohit: I'll open a PR to remove the networkpolicy change from the config bundle and push immediate patch. ETA 8m.
ian: for nodes, temp mitigation: kill the preStop script by editing the daemonset to remove lifecycle hook, then drain/uncordon. but that's risky. alternative: restart kubelet on eu-gpu-4 to break stuck Terminating pods (less intrusive)
sara: do kubelet restart on eu-gpu-4 and eu-gpu-3 after patch applied. who can run?
ian: I'm on it. ```sudo systemctl restart kubelet``` and monitoring termination.
ian: kubelet restart done on eu-gpu-4. Terminating pods cleared. node ready.
tara: networkpolicy revert applied by mohit. telemetry pods came back. ingress errors at edge are down to <0.5% now
customer-success: customers reporting normal behavior. no new errors in last 4m. they want timeline/notes for post-incident summary
sara: assigning postmortem. primary cause: configmap bundle included two changes in same rollout — (1) typo in HPA metricName causing scale-to-zero during canary, (2) unintended networkpolicy restricting egress to S3 which caused preStop hooks to hang. Secondary: rollout to canary with traffic still active amplified impact.
mohit: recommend: a) block config bundles that touch HPA and networkpolicy together in same deploy, b) add CI lint to validate metric names against our metrics API, c) require kill-switch smoke test before configmap rollout to production, d) run preStop scripts with egress fallback + timeout
sara: handoff to oncall followup. I'm marking incident resolved for immediate customer impact. we'll draft a short customer-facing blurb and a full postmortem doc. cc @customer-success for comms
oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-3377 status=mitigated resolved_by=sara time_to_ack=00:00:20 time_to_mitigate=00:06:14
sara: thanks team. I'll write the postmortem and link it here when ready.
